purpose: Qualify the independently observed response-bound correction to P8; not a claim of official >900
candidate: P8 conservative with every hypothetical communication clipped to [-100,100], including marginal-slot allocation and the public response learned after censoring; no depth2, portfolio, coverage13, or prefix change
mechanism_gate: all 108 observed updates match the bounded model; test both signs, both response factors, three successive uses, and initial values outside bounds without clipping scans
development: P9 distribution 901-902, four independently resampled families, seven shifts including near_upper_bound and saturated_hubs; archive controls run in the corrected environment

confirmation.unlock: only after source hash freeze and development completion; no threshold or candidate tuning on confirmation

secondary_comparator: official-best historical starnet-public-greedy-experimental-20260908.zip; report every stratum and aggregate even if it outranks the correction
primary_estimand: equal-weight average across the 28 family-by-shift cells, paired on the same initial seed
uncertainty: bootstrap repetition blocks within each topology family while preserving all seven paired shifts together; 10000 draws with seed 20260913; report percentile 95% CI
release_gate: mechanism gate and real framework/public API/resource tests pass
84/84 confirmation pairs complete with no illegal actions, action failures, nonfinite score or planner errors
mean gain against original P8 is positive and bootstrap lower 2.5 percentile is strictly positive
each of seven shift means versus original P8 is nonnegative
all five shifts whose maximum reachable w is below 100 retain original P8 scores within 1e-8; any difference must be explained and invalidates simple equivalence classification
actual generated ZIP executes the bounded estimator and real LLM final-choice route on a saturated development case
scope_note: This is a correction to a demonstrated environment-model mismatch. It has a separate prespecified gate against the deployed P8 behavior; it does not retroactively change the broad P9 strategy-development ranking against the historical official best. A local pass cannot establish the hidden official score.
